title: Knight Steps, Rook Strikes
setup: The white rook on e1 is aimed at the black king, and White's own knight is the only thing in the way.
hint: Every knight move uncovers the rook. Only one of them also lands on something.
explanation:
## The Idea

While the knight sits on e4 the rook does nothing. Move it and the rook's line opens the same instant: the piece that moves is not the piece that attacks.

Several knight moves give that check, but only {{Nd6+}} does a second job, attacking the rook on c8. It is a **double check** too, so nothing can block and taking one checker leaves the other.

The king has three squares. {{Kd8}} keeps it close, and {{Nxc8}} wins the rook — the king takes back, and the exchange is yours.
